title: Inner product and vector Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $B$ be a basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ whose constant-one element is indexed by $0$ and which is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product. Let $V$ be a real inner product space that is also a normed additive group, and let $n$ be a natural number. For any function $f:\Omega^n\to V$, multi-index $a\in\iota^n$, and vector $v\in V$, the inner product of $v$ with the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $a$ equals the scalar Fourier coefficient at $a$ of the function $x\mapsto\langle v,f(x)\rangle$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty basis index set $\iota$ with decidable equality

The basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
